package techversion

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// CreateTechVersionInput holds create data.
type CreateTechVersionInput struct {
	TechID  int
	Version string
}

// CreateTechVersion creates a tech version.
type CreateTechVersion struct {
	TechVersions repository.TechVersionRepository
	Techs        repository.TechRepository
}

// Handle creates or returns existing tech version.
func (uc CreateTechVersion) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateTechVersionInput) (domain.TechVersion, error) {
	techID := in.TechID
	version := strings.TrimSpace(in.Version)
	if techID <= 0 || version == "" {
		return domain.TechVersion{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if uc.Techs != nil {
		if _, err := uc.Techs.GetByID(ctx, techID); err != nil {
			return domain.TechVersion{}, err
		}
	}
	if uc.TechVersions == nil {
		return domain.TechVersion{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	existing, err := uc.TechVersions.GetByTechAndVersion(ctx, techID, version)
	if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return domain.TechVersion{}, err
	}
	if existing != nil {
		return *existing, nil
	}
	techVersion := domain.TechVersion{
		TechID:    techID,
		Version:   version,
		CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
	}
	if err := uc.TechVersions.Create(ctx, techVersion); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			existing, err := uc.TechVersions.GetByTechAndVersion(ctx, techID, version)
			if err == nil && existing != nil {
				return *existing, nil
			}
		}
		return domain.TechVersion{}, err
	}
	created, err := uc.TechVersions.GetByTechAndVersion(ctx, techID, version)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TechVersion{}, err
	}
	return *created, nil
}
